other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular school teacher or Head of School with at least ten years of service
Retired teachers are generally ineligible, except if they served at least four months of the relevant calendar year

School must be a recognised primary, middle, secondary or higher secondary school under categories such as State/UT government schools, local‑body schools, aided schools, private schools affiliated to State/UT boards, Central Government schools (KVs, JNVs, Sainik Schools, AEES, EMRS), CBSE‑affiliated schools (excluding the Central Government schools listed), and CISCE‑affiliated schools (excluding the Central Government schools listed)
benefits_summary: Public recognition by the President or Vice President of India on Teacher's Day for meritorious teachers
